FOREVE_CHARACTER_ROTAN_CHARACTER.title: Rotan
FOREVE_CHARACTER_ROTAN_CHARACTER.descrip: A young swordswoman wielding a dark blade. Her techniques build around Strike, each slash empowering the next.
FOREVE_CHARACTER_OGIER_CHARACTER.title: Ogier
FOREVE_CHARACTER_OGIER_CHARACTER.descrip: A knight bound by an oath of honor. He gains Honor by fully blocking attacks; Honor empowers his attacks and can be spent on mighty techniques.
FOREVE_CHARACTER_OGIER_CHARACTER.cardsMo: Ogier's cards now appear in rewards and shops.
FOREVE_CHARACTER_DORE_CHARACTER.title: Dore
FOREVE_CHARACTER_DORE_CHARACTER.descript: A medic sustained by regeneration and Silver Key energy. She trades life for offense and defense, and can arrange her deck into perfect order.
FOREVE_CHARACTER_DORE_CHARACTER.cardsMod: Dore's cards now appear in rewards and shops.
